description: Use when a travel request asks about forecasts, severe weather, seasonal conditions, or weather-related risk for a destination or route.
planning_instructions: Resolve the destination to coordinates before requesting forecast data when the weather capability requires coordinates.
Use forecast horizon and confidence when assessing whether weather may disrupt the trip.
response_instructions: Separate observed conditions from forecast uncertainty and call out material travel risks.
tool_hints: Select current conditions, forecast, severe-weather alert, or historical-weather capabilities according to the time period and risk in the request.
When the selected weather capability requires coordinates, also select a location-resolution capability that can produce them from the user's destination.

resources.name: weather-risk-checklist
resources.description: A compact checklist for weather-sensitive travel recommendations.
resources.load_when: Load when severe weather, a long forecast horizon, or disruption risk affects a recommendation.
resources.content: Check forecast horizon, confidence, precipitation, wind, temperature extremes, and official travel advisories. Express long-range forecasts with explicit uncertainty.
